reconciliationPolicy.unit: relative percent; individual snapshot residuals retain the source field unit
reconciliationPolicy.rule: A relative difference <=0.01% is accepted and retained in residual metadata without altering printed values or inserting a balancing plug. A difference >0.01% requires manual review. Relative tolerance never waives missing source evidence, OCR digit errors, incorrect report scope, or an unreported FX field.
reconciliationPolicy.supersedesPreviousRule: Replaces the former blanket acceptedAbsoluteDifferenceMillionVnd=10 rule as a standalone acceptance threshold.
reconciliationPolicy.passCondition: Arithmetic residual <= 0.01% is accepted and retained in metadata; no balancing plug.
reconciliationPolicy.semanticExceptions: Tolerance never suppresses source-line misclassification, unit/consolidation/period mismatch, unverified OCR, material reclassification, or cross-period cash-basis mismatch > 0.01%.
reconciliationPolicy.checkpointRule: Commit a checkpoint immediately when each ticker passes required checks; store source evidence, periods, tests, residuals, data commit and CI runs.
reconciliationPolicy.noReloadRule: Skip any ticker/domain already passed under the same standard version unless a new source, explicit correction, standard change affecting it, or regression failure requires reopening.
